title: mentha × kerneri var. peracuta
intro: Mentha × kerneri var. peracuta, commonly known as Bergamot mint, is a hybrid species within the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce nausea, and alleviate stress, as well as its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha × kerneri var. peracuta are attributed to its calming effects on the nervous system, its ability to reduce inflammation, and its role in improving respiratory function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, particularly menthone, menthofuran, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
